description: This file defines a React component 'AssignmentFilters' that provides filtering and sorting UI for a list of assignments. It manages internal filter state, applies filtering logic to assignment data, and triggers callbacks with the filtered results. It imports external components, hooks, and constants to facilitate filtering and UI rendering.

methods.name: AssignmentFilters
methods.description: React functional component that renders filtering and sorting UI for assignments, manages filter state, applies filtering logic, and provides filtered data via callback.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Handles the application of all current filters and sorting options to the assignments list, and calls 'onFilter' callback with the filtered array.
